description: Modern 2026-07-28 fixtures that the macos Swift handler does not yet implement. Each entry maps a modern case name (the fixture's name field) to the reason it currently mismatches its target shape. A runner treats a listed case as passing while it mismatches, and fails if the case unexpectedly matches (a signal the feature landed and the entry should be removed). Empty after M1: the Swift dual-era adapter implements every modern case (era classification, envelope validation, server/discover, response decoration, cache hints, modern ping removal), and the tool-order/tool-list cases match the checked-in definition order.
